note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The proposed ordinary use is attributed to a fictional source and is not endorsed; no outcome is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative

presets.description: Substantive alternative: four user-supplied levels, a different term; A's definition sits in the first level (the top flag, a different section) and B's proposal comes from a fictional glossary compiler with a different ordinary use.
